subject: Fix cluster bus self-forget use-after-free (#4675)
reason: The fix guards against a cluster-bus use-after-free triggered only by a forged/malformed PING with a FORGOTTEN_NODE extension naming the sender node itself (n == sender in clusterProcessPingExtensions). This cannot arise from normal operation: a node's FORGOTTEN_NODE gossip is built from its own blacklist, which is populated by CLUSTER FORGET, and CLUSTER FORGET refuses to forget myself, so a node never legitimately names itself as forgotten. The only trigger is hand-crafted binary clusterMsg bytes written to the cluster bus port (port+10000), which is exactly what the added TCL test does via
